title: ps: support negated status filter
body:
Allows 'status!=value' in container filters, matching the existing 'label!' handling and the negation syntax of 'podman image list'. Also treats 'status!' as an explicit status filter in ps so that non-running containers are considered without --all.

Related to #21398

## Summary

`podman ps` accepted negated filters for `label` (`label!=...`) but rejected them for other filters, e.g. `podman ps --filter 'status=running'` failed with `Error: status! is an invalid filter`, while `podman image list` supports negation. This PR adds a negated `status` filter for containers.

## Changes

- `pkg/domain/filters/containers.go`: handles `status!` alongside `status`, sharing the status validation along with the normalization of `stopped` and `exited` forms.
- `pkg/ps/ps.go`: `ps` includes non-running containers when a `status` filter is present. This now also applies to `status!`; as without it `podman ps --filter 'status!=running'` always returned an empty list.
- Tests: e2e cases added to `test/e2e/ps_test.go` to check for negated status filter without `--all`, multiple negated status filters and negated status filter with invalid value.

## Behavior notes (feedback welcome)

- Multiple negated values on one key combine as an AND (all excluded), e.g. `status!=exited --filter status!=created` hides both, as is consistent with the `reference!=foo,reference!=bar` behavior mentioned in the issue.
- Different keys to the filter `status!` combine as an AND, as before.
- An invalid value (`status!=bogus`) returns the same error as `status=bogus`.

## Manual testing

Built from this branch (`podman version 6.2.0-dev`), with containers in
running, exited, created and paused states.
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps -a
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND       CREATED         STATUS                     PORTS       NAMES
863ff4a5094a  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     21 minutes ago  Up 4 seconds                           web2
d4dcfd97ee14  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  echo hello    21 minutes ago  Exited (0) 21 minutes ago              done1
e33c6bc1bad5  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sh -c exit 3  21 minutes ago  Exited (3) 21 minutes ago              failed1
9a795a5afa5d  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     21 minutes ago  Created                                idle1
d9a3628bb035  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     21 minutes ago  Paused                                 paused1
3a1d9c685321  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     21 minutes ago  Up 4 seconds                           web1
```

- Core case without -a (returned an empty list before the change):
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps --filter 'status!=running'
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND       CREATED         STATUS                     PORTS       NAMES
d4dcfd97ee14  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  echo hello    22 minutes ago  Exited (0) 22 minutes ago              done1
e33c6bc1bad5  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sh -c exit 3  22 minutes ago  Exited (3) 22 minutes ago              failed1
9a795a5afa5d  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     22 minutes ago  Created                                idle1
d9a3628bb035  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     22 minutes ago  Paused                                 paused1
```
- Same with -a: 
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps -a --filter 'status!=running'
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND       CREATED         STATUS                     PORTS       NAMES
d4dcfd97ee14  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  echo hello    22 minutes ago  Exited (0) 22 minutes ago              done1
e33c6bc1bad5  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sh -c exit 3  22 minutes ago  Exited (3) 22 minutes ago              failed1
9a795a5afa5d  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     22 minutes ago  Created                                idle1
d9a3628bb035  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600     22 minutes ago  Paused                                 paused1
```
- Two negations, which combine as an AND: 
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps --filter 'status!=exited' --filter 'status!=running'
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND     CREATED         STATUS      PORTS       NAMES
9a795a5afa5d  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600   22 minutes ago  Created                 idle1
d9a3628bb035  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600   22 minutes ago  Paused                  paused1
```
- Negation mixed with another key:
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps --filter 'status!=exited' --filter 'label=env=prod'
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND     CREATED         STATUS         PORTS       NAMES
3a1d9c685321  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600   22 minutes ago  Up 55 seconds              web1
```

- The `stopped` alias which should behave like `exited`:
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps --filter 'status!=exited' --filter 'label=env=prod'
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE                            COMMAND     CREATED         STATUS         PORTS       NAMES
3a1d9c685321  docker.io/library/alpine:latest  sleep 600   22 minutes ago  Up 55 seconds              web1
```
- Invalid value: 
```
shounak@shounak-HP  ~/Documents/podman   status-negated-filter  podman ps --filter 'status!=bogus'; echo "exit code: $?"
Error: unknown container state: bogus: invalid argument
exit code: 125
```

## Note for reviewers 
The e2e suite could not run locally (its `SynchronizedBeforeSuite` setup failed in my environment, which has an older `pasta` than this build expects). This PR is posted as a draft for that reason.
